latin_incipit: Locus iste a Deo factus est
english: This place was made by God, a mystery above all value: it is without reproof. V. O God, on whom choirs of angels attend, hear the prayers of thy servants.

latin_incipit: Benedicta et venerabilis es, Virgo Maria
english: Thou art blessed, and worthy of our respects, O Mary, the Virgin, who, without prejudice to thy virginity, didst become the mother of the Saviour. V. O Virgin-mother of God! he whom the whole world cannot contain, became man, and was shut up in thy womb.
After child-birth thou remainedst still a pure Virgin: O Mother of God, intercede for us. Alleluia.

Rejoice, O Virgin Mary, thou alone hast destroyed all heresies. V. Who didst believe the words of Gabriel the archangel. V. Whilst a Virgin, thou didst bring forth him that was God and man; and after child-birth didst remain a pure Virgin. V. O Mother of God, intercede for us.
This is a wise virgin, and one of the number of the prudent. Alleluia.
Thou art truly happy, O sacred Virgin Mary, and most worthy of praise: for out of thee arose the Sun of righteousness, Christ our God.
Blessed is the womb of Mary, the Virgin which bore the Son of the eternal Father.
Hail, Holy Mother, who didst bring forth the King who reigns over heaven and earth forevermore.
A sucker of Jesse hath budded: a Virgin hath brought forth him, who is God and man: God hath restored peace by reconciling in his person the highest things with the lowest. Alleluia.
Blessed art thou, O Virgin Mary, who didst bear the Creator of all things: thou didst bring forth him, who made thee, and remainest a Virgin for ever. Alleluia.
